# The physical or legal object

A tonne of a mineral, a lease, an invoice, a building, a barrel. It lives in the world of courts, warehouses, and surveys — not in storage slots.

By the end of this lesson you should be able to teach the title — The physical or legal object — without a marketing slide.

## The object

A tonne of a mineral, a lease, an invoice, a building, a barrel. It lives in the world of courts, warehouses, and surveys — not in storage slots. Intermediate treats this as an object with a contract, a function, and an explorer row. If you cannot point at those, you have a vibe. Global learners get the same objects. There is no local exception.

## How you check it

Open the bookmarked explorer on the named chain. Read the function names. Read the roles. Read timestamps on vesting if any. Do not use a search ad. Do not use a chat screenshot as evidence. Evidence is the chain and the verified source, with the caveat that verified is a compiler match, not an audit.

## How it fails

It fails when an admin path exists that the slide omitted, when a tax flips, when a vest is only a labelled EOA, or when someone asks you to skip the explorer because ‘the community already checked.’ Communities are not bytecode.

We will not tell you this object is a reason to buy Crystal Stones or anything else. We will not take tuition in Crystal Stones. We will not ask for a seed to ‘apply tokenomics.’ Staff do not DM unlock calendars that require a payment.

TABLE
Check | Honest | Costume
rwa objects function | Named in source and explorer | A PNG
Admin | Listed with address | ‘Renounced’ with a live proxy

Money | USDT checkout on the academy page | A token dump address
ENDTABLE

You pay Intermediate only as USDT BEP-20 on the academy page.
